invariants: gift contents are already assembled and visibly abundant
no branding, borders or body-card captions
the sequence reads as gifts made by one attentive giver
variability: container: wicker basket, tote, gift box, tumbler
recipient or theme: cozy, beauty, snacks, character, practical
location: passenger seat, back seat, bed, home surface
scale: one small bundle through a whole carload
selectionRule: Use saves as engagement evidence only after semantic fit and visual clarity pass. Reject product ads, text-heavy graphics, collages, unassembled products and unrelated car-care baskets even when their save counts are higher.
